title: RDT-3D: Resolution-Decoupled Training for High-Fidelity 3D Geometry Generation
abstract: High-fidelity 3D geometry generation requires maintaining global structural coherence alongside fine-grained surface details. While recent coarse-to-fine frameworks leverage Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) to condition local queries, we reveal a critical training-inference resolution discrepancy: coordinate guidance and geometric supervision are aligned during training, whereas inference decodes high-resolution geometry from coarse spatial coordinates. This mismatch introduces a severe distribution shift that degrades fine details. To overcome this, we propose Resolution-Decoupled Training (RDT), which anchors RoPE guidance at 512 resolution while supervising geometry at 1536, enabling robust detail extrapolation. Additionally, to eliminate high-resolution data bottlenecks, we present Dual3D-300K, a large-scale paired dataset comprising 300K watertight 3D point clouds explicitly aligned across 512 and 1536 resolutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RDT substantially improves sharp geometric regions, while Dual3D-300K offers a scalable benchmark for high-resolution 3D generation.

analysis.sourceNote: Full-text review of exact version 2611.06141v1, 5 pages, with visual inspection of key pages. All numerical results are author-reported and were not reproduced here. No public implementation was confirmed.
analysis.ideaZh: RDT-3D把RoPE坐标固定在512粗网格、shape监督保持1536，避免refiner训练时偷用过精确的空间位置。作者报告Toys4K的CD由同架构baseline 0.0184降至0.0164；值得精读训练条件失配，但粗GT量化不等于真实stage-1拓扑错误。
analysis.motivationZh: 高分辨率refiner训练看精确坐标，推理却只得到coarse mesh位置时，如何消除这种condition失配？
analysis.methodZh: 图像先由Hunyuan3D/TRELLIS生成coarse mesh，再以其采样坐标引导vecset DiT预测高分辨率shape latents，经VAE和Marching Cubes得到mesh。Dual3D-300K提供同坐标系的512/1536成对watertight训练样本。
methodFlow: 图像条件与512粗网格坐标
coarse mesh提供推理坐标并预测fine latents
analysis.experimentsZh: Toys4K严格隔离；所有方法ICP对齐后以409600点计算CD和阈值0.05 F-score。 作者报告RDT CD=0.0164、F-score=0.6886；UltraShape为0.0185/0.6676。 (Table 2, p.4) 作者报告同架构baseline 0.0184/0.6651，jitter 0.0187/0.6659。 (Table 3, p.4) 比较Hunyuan3D-2.1、UltraShape、TRELLIS、TRELLIS.2；仅单一Toys4K几何评测，未给texture/part/manufacturability结论。 architecture与hyperparameters一致，对照1536→1536、坐标jitter和512→1536；未隔离300K数据规模/来源效应，也未扫所有resolution。
analysis.insightZh: 核心不是新DiT，而是将空间定位分辨率与目标几何分辨率解耦；随机jitter对照支持结构化量化不同于普通坐标扰动。
analysis.evidenceZh: 训练用量化GT坐标而非生成coarse mesh，以避免严重结构漂移造成不稳定。 (Sec.2.2, p.3); 模型采用UltraShape的RoPE vecset DiT，8×B200训练300k步、10240 tokens。 (Sec.4.1, p.4); 同架构RDT相对symmetric/jitter获得更低CD及更高F-score。 (Table 3, p.4)
analysis.caveatZh: 生成coarse mesh直接用于训练会造成过大noise和结构偏差，因此采用low-resolution GT。 量化GT仍保留正确整体拓扑，无法证明能修复stage-1缺失部件。 ICP和较宽F-score阈值下的表面指标不等于尺寸/装配精度。 数据声称将开放，正文未给可验证的公开实现链接。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 对3D generation的coarse-to-fine训练设计直接相关；可借鉴condition fidelity与target fidelity分开建模。
